arguments.value:
Fruit of Life Productions LLC agreed to provide sponsorship benefits for Kaya Fest to Eco Science Solutions, Inc. in exchange for a $250,000 payment due in full when the agreement was signed. In return, Eco Science would receive major event branding and promotional benefits, including naming rights for the main stage, vendor booths, VIP and general admission tickets, parking passes, banners, logo placement, social media mentions, and other sponsor recognition.

The agreement lasted from April 1, 2018 through April 30, 2018. The parties were independent contractors, and Fruit of Life kept all rights to Kaya Fest intellectual property. Eco Science could not use the festival’s name or branding in a way that implied endorsement without written permission. Eco Science also had to indemnify Fruit of Life, keep certain information confidential, carry $1 million in liability insurance if exhibiting, and handle its own banners. The agreement was governed by Florida law, disputes would go to arbitration, and neither party could assign the agreement without written consent.
